evidence.quote: Exports orders to CSV and XLSX.

gap_register.rationale: Every order system needs a way to reverse a charge
Needed by the platform's load balancer

findings.title: Discount ignored for single-item orders

evidence.note: discount only applied when more than one item

findings.title: No input validation on charge amount

evidence.note: amount passed to gateway unchecked; negative or string values accepted

findings.title: Stock reservation errors swallowed

evidence.note: order is created even when stock reservation fails

findings.title: Seed script not re-runnable

evidence.note: second run fails with duplicate key

findings.title: Wall-clock time read inside domain logic

evidence.note: time not injectable; tests cannot control it

findings.title: Order insert and stock reservation not in one transaction

evidence.note: a crash between insert and reserve leaves an order with no stock held

findings.title: Domain logic depends directly on the DB handle

evidence.note: no repository boundary; persistence details leak into the domain

findings.title: Orders and payments share no interface; payments reads the raw request

evidence.note: HTTP request object passed into payment logic

findings.title: Items are untyped dicts

evidence.quote: total = sum(i["price"] * i["qty"] for i in items)
evidence.note: no type or schema for items

findings.title: Single payment gateway assumed

evidence.note: no currency or provider abstraction

findings.disposition: won't fix: one payment provider is a deliberate business constraint through 2027

findings.title: Rounding and discount logic mixed in one function

evidence.note: float rounding for money; no money type

findings.title: One test covers one happy path

evidence.note: single test; create_order and charge untested

findings.title: XLSX export advertised but not implemented

evidence.quote: Run `make dev` to start. Exports orders to CSV and XLSX.

evidence.note: no export code at all

findings.title: No way to cancel or refund an order
Money handled as floats

evidence.note: float arithmetic for currency

findings.title: discount parameter silently ignored in a common case

evidence.note: callers passing a discount for one item get no error and no discount

findings.title: Quickstart command does not exist

evidence.note: no Makefile; quickstart fails at step 1

findings.title: README is one line and partly wrong

evidence.quote: Exports orders to CSV and XLSX.
evidence.note: claims features that do not exist

findings.title: No dependency manifest or dev setup
No standard Python project metadata
No deploy artifact or instructions
No CI

evidence.note: none present

findings.title: No logging anywhere
Total recomputed per insert with no batching

evidence.note: fine at current scale; noted for bulk imports

findings.title: Dependencies not declared or pinned
No versioning of the HTTP API
Check-then-act race on idempotency key

evidence.note: two concurrent requests with the same key can both charge

findings.title: No agent instructions or runnable verification commands

benchmarks.name: Robustness & Error Handling
caps_applied: Catch-all blocks that swallow errors in core paths → max 4
